## Definitions

- **Repair share**: `Defect:` lines (Defects after merge) over the merged PRs with an L3 verdict (the First-pass L3 accept denominator) that week; word counts as `tools/word_budget.py` counts them (D-152).
- **Week**: a plan week, Sunday 06:00 to Sunday 06:00 Mark's local time (UTC-4 assumed).
- **Usage**: the highest weekly-limit reading in LEDGER.md that week, all models / Fable only. Model usage is not metered per package; Mark's usage screen is the source (LEDGER B-6). Spend by model tier is approximated by this all-models / Fable-only split.
- **On-pace mark**: the share of the week elapsed at that reading. Usage at the mark is on pace for ~100% at reset.
- **Reqs newly covered**: growth of TRACE.md's covered count on main that week.
- **Usage per req**: weekly-limit points per requirement ID covered at the time of the reading (TRACE.md's last snapshot at or before the reading, minus the count before the week); the reading's time is shown beside it. Stands in for tokens per merged requirement until tokens are metered.
- **Current week label**: the time of the week's highest usage reading; past 36 hours it adds the age of the newest input (reading, TRACE.md or BOARD.md snapshot) relative to "Data as of".
- **First-pass L3 accept**: PRs merged that week whose first review with a verdict (an L3 review stating `Verdict: accept|fix-list|reject`, or the verdict on its first line) was accept.
- **Escalation rate**: packages ever `escalated` on BOARD.md or by a work-item issue's state label over packages that ever reached `in review`, `merged` or `escalated`, up to that week.
- **Defects after merge**: `Defect: <package ID>` lines in the bodies of PRs merged that week (a fix to code already merged; see the PR template).
- **Defects per merged PR**: those lines over all PRs merged that week; the D-086 guard's defect measure.
- **CI flake rate**: commits that, within one workflow, had both a failed and a passed run or attempt, over commits with any finished run; counted in the week of the first run.
- **L3 rounds per merged PR**: distinct reviewed heads with an L3 verdict (OPERATING §4; a verdict naming no head counts alone), averaged over the PRs merged that week that had one. 1.0 means every PR was accepted on its first review (COST-1: rework is the main cost).
- **Usage per merged PR**: weekly-limit points per PR merged that week; the cost-per-package figure the operating model steers by (docs/OPERATING.md §6).
- **L3 causes**: the `Cause:` lines of fix-list and reject L3 reviews on PRs merged that week, by code (spec-gap, brief-gap, defect, scope; docs/OPERATING.md §4). `none` is a non-accept verdict without a Cause line.
- **Open BOARD rows**: rows queued, building, in review or escalated in the last BOARD.md of the week.
- **Follow-up rows added**: rows first seen on BOARD.md that week whose ID ends `-f<N>`, `-r<N>` or `-l<N>`, or whose package text says `(release` and cites a review. **Per merged PR**: that count over PRs merged that week.
- **Promotions later to release**: rows first seen that week whose text cites a LATER.md line (`LATER <ID>`).
- **Stale PRs (48 h)**: open PRs, held drafts included (D-098), with no update for 48 hours at run time; counted for the current week only.
- **Open PRs by lane**: open PRs per lane (a `lane:<name>` label, docs/LANES.md; no label is the peers) against a cap of about 10; current week only.
- **red** / **n/a**: red marks a week above the D-086 baseline; `n/a` means the data to compute a column is absent (never printed as 0).
- **Closed weeks**: once a finished week is recorded, its L3, defect and flake cells are kept as recorded; the other columns are recomputed from git and LEDGER.md each run.
